name: Burj Khalifa
description: Standing at an astounding 828 meters, the Burj Khalifa is the world's tallest building and the ultimate symbol of modern engineering. Visitors can enjoy panoramic 360-degree views of Dubai's futuristic skyline and desert horizon from its world-famous observation decks.
address: 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai, Dubai, UAE

userReviews.author: Sarah M.
userReviews.comment: Unbelievable sunset view from level 148! Booking in advance is a must.

name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
description: This architectural masterpiece features 82 white marble domes, gold-leaf chandeliers, and the world's largest hand-knotted carpet. It offers a profound cultural experience welcoming visitors from around the world to marvel at Islamic design and serene reflective pools.
address: Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Street, Abu Dhabi, UAE

userReviews.author: Elena R.
userReviews.comment: Serene, peaceful, and majestic. The marble work and blue lighting at dusk are unmatched.

name: Museum of the Future
description: Engineered as an architectural marvel engraved with Arabic calligraphy, this museum transports visitors 50 years into the future. Through immersive storytelling, virtual reality, and interactive exhibits, it showcases groundbreaking innovations in space, wellness, and climate science.
address: Sheikh Zayed Rd, Trade Centre 2, Dubai, UAE

name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
description: Designed by Jean Nouvel, this premier art museum appears to float on the Arabian Gulf under a magnificent 'rain of light' geometric dome. It bridges Eastern and Western art, displaying centuries of historical artifacts alongside world-renowned international masterpieces.
address: Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Global Village Dubai
description: Global Village is a spectacular multicultural festival park featuring over 90 country pavilions, street food bazaars, carnival rides, and nightly fireworks. It offers an incredible world journey filled with international performances and authentic artisanal crafts.
address: Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE

name: Jebel Jais Mountain
description: Soaring over 1,900 meters above sea level, Jebel Jais is the highest peak in the United Arab Emirates offering dramatic mountain vistas and cool breezes. Thrill-seekers can ride the world's longest zipline or hike along scenic ridge trails with sweeping views of the Hajar mountains.
address: Jebel Jais Mountain Road, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

name: Dubai Frame
description: Standing 150 meters high in Zabeel Park, the golden Dubai Frame bridges the gap between old and new Dubai. Walking across its transparent glass skywalk presents breathtaking views of historic Deira on one side and towering Downtown skyscrapers on the other.
address: Zabeel Park Gate 4, Dubai, UAE

name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighborhood
description: Stepping into Al Fahidi offers an enchanting glimpse into mid-19th century Dubai with traditional wind-tower architecture and narrow winding alleyways. Explore art galleries, courtyard cafes, and spice souks right along historic Dubai Creek.
address: Al Fahidi St, Bur Dubai, Dubai, UAE

name: Dubai Miracle Garden
description: Home to over 150 million blooming flowers arranged into sensational 3D sculptures, including a full-sized Emirates A380 airplane clad in floral petals. It is the world's largest natural flower garden, creating a vibrant paradise in the heart of the desert.
address: Al Barsha South 3, Dubai, UAE

name: Hatta Wadi Hub
description: Nestled in the majestic Hajar mountains, Hatta is Dubai's outdoor adventure haven for kayaking on turquoise dam waters and mountain biking. Visitors can enjoy glamping, hiking trails, and heritage village tours amidst breathtaking natural landscapes.
address: Hatta Mountain Area, Dubai, UAE

name: Sharjah Art Museum
description: One of the largest art venues in the Gulf region hosting an extensive permanent collection of modern Arab art and regional masterpieces. Located in Sharjah's Heritage Area, it features temporary international exhibitions and interactive art workshops.
address: Al Shuwaihean, Heritage Area, Sharjah, UAE

name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi
description: The world's first Ferrari-branded theme park features Formula Rossa, the fastest roller coaster on earth accelerating to 240 km/h in 4.9 seconds. Housed under an iconic red roof on Yas Island, it offers thrilling rides and immersive racing simulators for adrenaline lovers.
address: Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Ain Dubai
description: Located on Bluewaters Island, Ain Dubai is the world's tallest observation wheel standing over 250 meters high. Air-conditioned glass cabins provide unmatched panoramic views across JBR beach and the glittering Dubai marina coast.
address: Bluewaters Island, Dubai, UAE

name: Qasr Al Watan Palace
description: A working presidential palace in Abu Dhabi that invites the public to discover Emirati craftsmanship, governance, and rich cultural heritage. Its breathtaking Great Hall, intricate mosaics, and evening light and sound show create an unforgettable royal experience.
address: Al Ras Al Akhdar, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Dubai Mall & Dancing Fountain
description: The Dubai Mall is the ultimate shopping and entertainment venue featuring over 1,200 stores, an giant indoor aquarium, and an ice rink. Outside on Burj Lake, the world's largest choreographed fountain show dances to classical and contemporary music every evening.
address: Financial Center Street, Downtown Dubai, UAE

name: Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark
description: Located on Palm Jumeirah, Aquaventure is the world's largest waterpark boasting over 105 record-breaking slides and attractions. Brave the leap of faith through a shark lagoon or relax along a kilometer of private white sand beach.
address: Atlantis The Palm, Crescent Rd, Dubai, UAE

name: The View at The Palm
description: Perched 240 meters high on the 52nd floor of Nakheel Tower, The View offers 360-degree views of Palm Jumeirah and the Arabian Gulf. Interactive exhibits detail the extraordinary engineering behind creating Dubai's world-famous artificial island palm.
address: Palm Jumeirah Rd, Palm Tower, Dubai, UAE

name: Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi
description: The world's largest indoor theme park on Yas Island brings Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Bugs Bunny, and Scooby-Doo to life. Featuring 29 state-of-the-art rides across six immersive lands, it promises endless entertainment in climate-controlled comfort.
address: Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Yas Marina Circuit
description: Host venue of the annual Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, Yas Marina Circuit is a premier motorsports facility. Visitors can take guided venue tours, drive high-performance sports cars, or cycle along the illuminated F1 track during community fitness nights.
address: Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Qasr Al Hosn Fort
description: Qasr Al Hosn is the oldest standing stone building in Abu Dhabi, constructed in the 1760s as a watchtower to protect sea trade. Restored into a national museum, it tells the captivating story of Abu Dhabi's evolution from a pearl fishing village to a modern metropolis.
address: Rashid Bin Saeed Al Maktoum St, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Mangrove National Park
description: Protecting 75% of the total mangrove forest area in the UAE, this lush sanctuary is home to flamingos, herons, and marine life. Guided kayak tours and wooden boardwalks allow nature lovers to explore peaceful waterways along Abu Dhabi's coast.
address: Anantara Eastern Mangroves, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Al Ain Oasis UNESCO World Heritage
description: Spread over 1,200 hectares in the Garden City of Al Ain, this UNESCO World Heritage Site shelters 147,000 date palms. Shaded pathways and an ancient 3,000-year-old 'falaj' irrigation system showcase sustainable traditional desert farming.
address: Al Mutawaa, Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Jebel Hafeet Mountain Peak
description: Rising 1,240 meters above Al Ain, Jebel Hafeet is the UAE's second highest mountain featuring a world-class winding highway. At the summit, visitors enjoy panoramic views over Oman and Al Ain desert, as well as natural hot springs at Green Mubazzarah base.
address: Jebel Hafeet Mountain Rd, Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Al Jahili Fort
description: Built in 1892 to protect the oasis city of Al Ain and its palm groves, Al Jahili is one of the UAE's largest mudbrick fortresses. Set amidst landscaped gardens, it houses an exhibition dedicated to British explorer Sir Wilfred Thesiger.
address: Castle St, Al Jahili, Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental
description: Emirates Palace is a luxury hotel famed for its Arabian palatial grandeur, dome ceilings decorated in 22-karat gold leaf, and private marina. Visitors can drop in for signature gold-dusted cappuccino or stroll across 85 hectares of gardens.
address: West Corniche Road, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Saadiyat Public Beach
description: Famous for its turquoise waters and pristine white sand dunes, Saadiyat Beach is an eco-friendly coast on Saadiyat Island. It is an active nesting ground for endangered Hawksbill sea turtles, offering sun loungers and water sport activities.
address: Saadiyat Island Beach, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization
description: Situated on the Majarrah waterfront, this museum displays over 5,000 rare Islamic artifacts including manuscripts, scientific inventions, coins, and textiles under a spectacular gilded central dome depicting the zodiac night sky.
address: Corniche St, Al Majarrah, Sharjah, UAE

name: Al Majaz Waterfront & Musical Fountain
description: Al Majaz Waterfront overlooks the scenic Khalid Lagoon with lush green lawns, jogging tracks, dining terraces, and splash parks. In the evening, the Sharjah Musical Fountain performs sound, light, and laser water jet shows.
address: Khalid Lake Trail, Al Majaz, Sharjah, UAE

name: Rain Room Sharjah
description: Created by Random International, Rain Room is an immersive art installation allowing visitors to walk through a continuous downpour of water without getting wet. 3D tracking sensors detect human motion and halt the rain wherever you step.
address: Al Mujarrah, Sharjah Art Foundation, Sharjah, UAE

name: Mleiha Archaeological Centre
description: Mleiha uncovers human history dating back tens of thousands of years with Bronze Age tombs, pre-Islamic fortresses, and desert fossil rocks. Thrill-seekers can combine historical museum tours with desert dune buggies and stargazing under desert skies.
address: Mleiha Road, Sharjah Desert, UAE

name: Al Noor Island & Butterfly House
description: Located in Khalid Lagoon, Al Noor Island is a serene eco-sanctuary featuring art sculptures, a lit Literature Pavilion, and a climate-controlled Butterfly House home to over 500 exotic tropical butterfly species.
address: Buhaira Corniche, Khalid Lagoon, Sharjah, UAE

name: Khorfakkan Amphitheatre & Waterfall
description: Set against the Hajar mountains on Sharjah's east coast, this Roman-inspired open-air amphitheatre holds over 3,500 spectators. Adjacent to it is a spectacular 43-meter manmade waterfall carved out of natural mountain rock.
address: Rugaylat Rd, Khorfakkan, Sharjah, UAE

name: Al Suhub Rest Area Khorfakkan
description: Built 580 meters above sea level in Khorfakkan, Al Suhub resembles a flying saucer structure offering panoramic 360-degree views of the Gulf of Oman. Visitors can dine at its mountain-top restaurant while watching clouds roll over the peaks.
address: Al Suhub Mountain Rd, Khorfakkan, Sharjah, UAE

name: Suwaidi Pearls Farm
description: Located in Al Rams mangrove lagoon, Suwaidi Pearls is the only cultivated pearl farm in the UAE. Board traditional wooden boats to learn the ancient art of Arabian pearl diving and open oysters to find your own cultured pearl.
address: Al Rams Lagoon, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

name: Dhayah Fort
description: Perched atop a steep 70-meter hill, Dhayah Fort is the only hilltop fortress surviving in the UAE, dating back to the 16th century. Climbing the 239 zigzagging steps rewards visitors with sweeping views of date palm oases and the Arabian Gulf.
address: Dhayah Hill, Al Rams, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

name: Al Marjan Island
description: Al Marjan Island is a group of four coral-shaped manmade islands extending 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf. Featuring luxury beach resorts, corniche promenades, and cycling paths, it hosts world-record New Year's Eve fireworks shows.
address: Al Marjan Island Blvd, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

name: Ras Al Khaimah National Museum
description: Housed in a former fort that served as the residence of the ruling Al Qasimi family until 1964, this museum displays archaeological finds from 5000 BC, ancient pottery, traditional weapons, and pearl diving artifacts.
address: Al Hisn Rd, Old Town, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE

name: Fujairah Fort & Heritage Village
description: Constructed in 1670, Fujairah Fort is one of the oldest and largest fortresses in the UAE, built from mud brick, stone, and palm fronds. Surrounding the fort is a heritage village demonstrating traditional Emirati farming, pottery, and daily life.
address: Fort Rd, Fujairah City, Fujairah, UAE

name: Al Bidyah Mosque
description: Dating back to 1446 AD, Al Bidyah is recognized as the oldest active mosque in the United Arab Emirates. Built of mud, stone, and gypsum, its distinctive four-domed roof stands without timber beams right near ancient watchtowers.
address: E99 Coastal Road, Al Bidyah, Fujairah, UAE

name: Snoopy Island Al Aqah
description: Named for its cartoon-like rock shape resembling Snoopy sleeping on his doghouse, this rocky islet off Al Aqah beach is a marine haven. Clear coastal waters make it the UAE's top destination for snorkeling with sea turtles, blacktip reef sharks, and colorful fish.
address: Al Aqah Beach, Fujairah, UAE

name: Sheikh Zayed Mosque Fujairah
description: The second largest mosque in the United Arab Emirates, this magnificent white structure features 65 domes and six 100-meter high minarets. It accommodates up to 28,000 worshippers and is illuminated brilliantly in green and blue at night.
address: Mohammed bin Zayed Rd, Fujairah City, UAE

name: Ajman Museum & Fort
description: Housed in an 18th-century fortress that served as the ruler's palace until 1970, Ajman Museum showcases ancient manuscripts, weapons, traditional medicine, and pearl diving tools. It preserves authentic dioramas depicting historic coastal life.
address: Bustan, Near Corniche, Ajman, UAE

name: Al Zorah Nature Reserve
description: Spanning over one million square meters of natural mangroves, Al Zorah is a biodiversity sanctuary home to 58 species of native and migratory birds. Visitors can take guided kayak tours through quiet channels to see pink flamingos up close.
address: Al Zorah Development, Ajman, UAE

name: Ajman Corniche
description: Stretching four kilometers along the Arabian Gulf, Ajman Corniche is a scenic palm-lined boulevard featuring sandy beaches, seaside cafes, and play areas. It is a favorite spot for family strolls, swimming, and watching golden sunsets.
address: Arabian Gulf St, Ajman, UAE

name: Umm Al Quwain Fort & Museum
description: Built in 1768 by Sheikh Rashid bin Majid Al Mualla, Al Ali Fort guarded the entrance to Umm Al Quwain town. Now restored as a heritage museum, it exhibits archaeological finds from Ed-Dur site, old weaponry, and royal artifacts.
address: Old Souk Area, Umm Al Quwain, UAE

name: Dreamland Aqua Park
description: One of the largest waterparks in the region, Dreamland Aqua Park spans 250,000 square meters of lush green palm gardens along the UAQ coastline. It offers over 30 thrilling water slides, a giant wave pool, and overnight camping tents.
address: Al Raafa, Umm Al Quwain, UAE

name: Dubai Safari Park
description: Dubai Safari Park is home to over 3,000 animals representing 78 species across five eco-themed villages: African, Asian, Arabian, Explorer, and Kids Farm. Open-air safari buses take visitors on immersive animal encounters.
address: Al Warqa 5, Dubai, UAE

name: Dubai Butterfly Garden
description: Located next to Dubai Miracle Garden, this climate-controlled indoor sanctuary houses 15,000 live butterflies from 50 species flying under ten custom domes. Educational exhibits demonstrate the fascinating caterpillar metamorphosis cycle.
address: Al Barsha South 3, Dubai, UAE

name: Ski Dubai Indoor Snow Resort
description: Located inside Mall of the Emirates, Ski Dubai is an indoor ski resort with 22,500 square meters of real snow maintained at -4°C year-round. Ski down snow slopes, ride the chairlift, or meet live Gentoo and King penguins.
address: Mall of the Emirates, Sheikh Zayed Rd, Dubai, UAE

name: The Green Planet Bio-Dome
description: The Green Planet is an indoor tropical rainforest enclosed within a glass bio-dome at City Walk Dubai. Featuring the world's largest manmade artificial tree, it shelters 3,000 plants and animals including sloths, toucans, and piranhas.
address: City Walk, Al Wasl, Dubai, UAE

name: Museum of Illusions Dubai
description: Situated in Al Seef heritage district along Dubai Creek, the Museum of Illusions features over 60 optical illusions, holograms, and mind-bending rooms like the Vortex Tunnel and Ames Room that challenge your perception of gravity.
address: Al Seef Heritage Area, Bur Dubai, Dubai, UAE

name: Kite Beach Dubai
description: Kite Beach is Dubai's premier outdoor beach destination, famous for kitesurfing, beach volleyball, jogging tracks, and gourmet food trucks with uninterrupted views of Burj Al Arab.
address: Jumeirah 3, Dubai, UAE

name: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah
description: Shaped like a billowing sail, the world-famous Burj Al Arab stands on its own island off Jumeirah beach as the global icon of Arabian luxury. Guided Inside Burj Al Arab tours grant access to the Royal Suite and atrium.
address: Jumeirah St, Umm Suqeim 3, Dubai, UAE
highlights: Inside Burj Al Arab Royal Suite Tour

name: Souk Madinat Jumeirah
description: Souk Madinat Jumeirah combines traditional Arabian bazaar shopping with 3 kilometers of meandering water canals navigated by wooden Abra boats. Restaurants along the waterways offer striking views of the illuminated Burj Al Arab.
address: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St, Dubai, UAE

name: Deep Dive Dubai
description: Holding the Guinness World Record for the world's deepest swimming pool at 60 meters, Deep Dive Dubai is filled with 14 million liters of fresh water. Divers explore an underwater sunken city complete with abandoned apartments, arcade games, and cars.
address: NAS Sports Complex, Dubai, UAE

name: Dubai Creek Harbour Promenade
description: Dubai Creek Harbour offers the ultimate postcard view of Downtown Dubai's skyline across peaceful waters. A pedestrian boardwalk features vibrant flamingo statues, waterfront dining, and yacht marinas.
address: Ras Al Khor Road, Dubai Creek Harbour, UAE
highlights: Ras Al Khor Flamingo Sanctuary View

name: Al Ain Zoo & African Safari
description: Founded in 1968 by Sheikh Zayed, Al Ain Zoo spans 400 hectares sheltering over 4,000 animals in spacious natural enclosures. Highlights include the 217-hectare Al Ain Safari, Sheikh Zayed Desert Learning Centre, and giraffe feeding.
address: Nahyan The First St, Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: SeaWorld Yas Island Abu Dhabi
description: The region's first marine life theme park on Yas Island features eight immersive realms with 100,000 marine animals. Walk through the Endless Ocean aquarium containing 25 million liters of water and ride the Manta roller coaster.
address: Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE

name: Al Seef Heritage & Promenade
description: Stretching 1.8 kilometers along Dubai Creek, Al Seef seamlessly blends modern dining and shopping with rustic, traditional Emirati architecture. Stroll past historic dhow boats, coral-stone buildings, and courtyard cafes.
address: Al Seef St, Dubai Creek, Dubai, UAE
